Job Title: Okta IAM Security Engineer
Location: Remote


System One is seeking an Okta IAM Security Engineer for a long-term remote opportunity. Ideal candidates will have hands-on experience with Okta, Identity Governance, SSO, MFA, application integrations, IAM automation, and Privileged Access Management (PAM) in an enterprise environment. This is a technical, hands-on role focused on engineering and optimizing Okta solutions, identity lifecycle management, access governance, and secure identity integrations.

Responsibilities

Manage the lifecycle of identities and IAM tools/platforms to ensure security and user experience are optimized.
Configure internal applications for use with Okta SSO and support Okta solutions for SSO, MFA, and federation.
Troubleshoot MFA and Single Sign-On issues with Okta and Active Directory.
Identify and implement technology, automation, and security improvements for IAM functions.
Facilitate onboarding of applications into Okta and enhance end-user experience with Okta.
Design, build, and maintain PAM processes to enforce least privilege principles and support M&A activities.
Support security incident response related to IAM, identify potential threats, and recommend mitigation strategies.
Collaborate with the Security Team to address security findings related to identity management.
Contribute to continuous learning and development of new security solutions.
Requirements
5+ years of experience with Identity and Access Management technologies.
5+ years of technical management experience implementing and managing IAM tools and platforms.
Extensive experience with PAM administration, configuration, implementation, and design.
Working knowledge of Okta, Multi-Factor Authentication, and Conditional Access.
Knowledge of SAML, OpenID, OAuth, and WS-Federation.
Experience with Okta FastPass and/or Okta Identity Governance is a plus.
Working knowledge of Windows Active Directory.
Ability to work productively remotely and communicate effectively in a virtual team environment.
Experience with IAM automation, troubleshooting, and support for account provisioning.
Strong customer focus, relationship building, and leadership skills.
Security-minded approach to analyzing business risks and prioritizing efforts.
